lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Laws for Sharing the Road — Bikes, Trucks & Horses
prompt: What is the recommended safe passing distance when overtaking a bicyclist on a Texas roadway?

options.text: Six inches of clearance provided the passenger vehicle mirrors are folded
One foot of clearance while sounding your vehicle horn continuously
At least three feet of lateral clearance (six feet for commercial trucks)
Motorists must never pass bicyclists; they must follow at bicycle speed
